tasks.subject: Task 1: Lesson domain (freezed)
tasks.description:
**Result (2026-09-18):** User-written `lib/shared/models/{lesson_block,lesson,unit}.dart`, generated `.freezed.dart` + `.g.dart`. `@Freezed(unionKey: 'type') sealed class LessonBlock` with `ExplanationBlock`/`QuizBlock`/`DrillBlock`/`InteractiveBlock`; `Lesson(id, title, xp, blocks)`, `Unit(id, title, lessons)`, all `fromJson(Map<String, Object?>)`. Verified by throwaway test (not kept): `Unit.fromJson` of the plan schema yields a `QuizBlock`, unknown `type` throws `CheckedFromJsonException`. Analyze clean. Known: `toJson` emits nested objects, not maps (`explicitToJson` default); app only reads, so unused. Checker flags `Unit` unused until Task 3.
**Files:** user's layout, see plan 'Folder decision'
**Goal:** Three value types. `LessonBlock` as `@Freezed(unionKey: 'type') sealed class` with four `const factory` variants: `explanation({required String tile, required String title, required String body})` → `ExplanationBlock`, `quiz({required String question, required List<String> hand, required List<String> options, required int correctIndex, required String feedback})` → `QuizBlock`, `drill()` → `DrillBlock`, `interactive()` → `InteractiveBlock`; `fromJson`. `Lesson({required String id, required String title, required int xp, required List<LessonBlock> blocks})` and `Unit({required String id, required String title, required List<Lesson> lessons})`, both `abstract class` + `const factory` + `fromJson`. Tiles stay strings in the model (`Tile.parse` happens in the widget), so content errors surface at render, not at load; `Tile` is not JSON-serialisable today and this keeps the domain free of the widget layer.
**Read:** CLAUDE.md freezed row; `~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev/freezed_annotation-3.1.0/lib/freezed_annotation.dart` lines 282–330 (`unionKey`, `unionValueCase`; default value case is the constructor name, so `"type": "explanation"` needs no extra option).
**Acceptance Criteria:** `dart run build_runner build -d` emits `lesson_block.freezed.dart` + `.g.dart` and the same for `lesson`, `unit`; `LessonBlock.fromJson({'type': 'quiz', …})` returns a `QuizBlock`; a `switch (block)` over the four variants compiles with no `default`.
**Verify:** `dart run build_runner build -d && flutter analyze`

tasks.subject: Task 4: ProgressRepository + UserProgress + in-memory impl
tasks.description:
**Files:** user's layout, see plan 'Folder decision'
**Goal:** `UserProgress({required Set<String> completedLessonIds, required int xp})` freezed, with `bool isCompleted(String lessonId)`. `abstract interface class ProgressRepository { Future<UserProgress> load(); Future<UserProgress> completeLesson(Lesson lesson); }` — takes the `Lesson` so XP comes from the data. `InMemoryProgressRepository` holds one `UserProgress` field, starts empty, is idempotent (completing twice adds XP once). **Unlock rule as one pure top-level function** in the same file as `UserProgress`: `LessonStatus statusOf(Unit unit, int lessonIndex, UserProgress progress)` with `enum LessonStatus { completed, current, locked }` — lesson `i` is `completed` if in the set, `current` if `i == 0` or lesson `i-1` is completed, else `locked`. Unit-level: a unit is playable only if the previous unit's last lesson is completed and it has lessons. This is the whole "engine" M1 allows; keep it a function so tests hit it directly.
**Read:** CLAUDE.md §3 "Progress is Firestore's…" (M4 swaps this impl; the interface must not leak in-memory details).
**Acceptance Criteria:** `completeLesson` on a fresh repo returns `xp == lesson.xp`; second call same lesson leaves XP unchanged; `statusOf` on lesson 2 flips locked → current once lesson 1 is completed.
**Result (2026-09-22):** User-written `lib/progress/user_progress.dart` (freezed `UserProgress(completedLessonIds, xp)` + `isCompleted`, `enum LessonStatus`, pure `statusOf(unit, lessonIndex, progress)` and `isUnitPlayable(units, unitIndex, progress)`), `progress_repository.dart` (`abstract interface class ProgressRepository { load(); completeLesson(Lesson) }`), `in_memory_progress_repository.dart` (`InMemoryProgressRepository`, idempotent, XP from the lesson). Claude-written, marked and registered: `test/progress/user_progress_test.dart`, `test/progress/in_memory_progress_repository_test.dart` (14 tests). `flutter analyze` clean, `flutter test` green, `check_conventions` only `TenpaiApp` -> `App`.
**Verify:** `dart run build_runner build -d && flutter analyze`
